note: Written by `fetch catalogue link-splits --write` from the committed link-survey exports. Measurement of whether a link answers over a seeded draw: never a ranking, never RouteEvidence.

analysis_ddbj.reason: Every link into a DDBJ analysis is DDBJ's dblink, and every one is unconfirmed: no record this project resolves reaches one, so there is nothing to draw.

analysis_ebi.reason: Derived from BioProject -> EBI analysis (ENA filereport, result=analysis), whose survey found no analysis for any of 300 PRJEBs, 300 PRJNAs or 137 PRJDBs: nothing this project resolves reaches one. The probe's PRJEB44468 was chosen because it has 106.

analysis_ncbi.reason: Every link into an NCBI analysis is DDBJ's dblink, and every one is unconfirmed: no record this project resolves reaches one, so there is nothing to draw.
